legend_notes: A3 ADMIT holds exactly one node, and it isn't a write-time admission check at all: it's agent.py:505-518's retrieval-time prefix dedup, pinned to A3 purely by its P-DEDUP primitive (SKELETON §2.3's stage-by-primitive rule) — MRAgent's only 'ADMIT' step runs during retrieval, not construction.

B4 APPRAISE looks like two parallel LLM rerank passes but one is dead code: select_finegrained_sentence_sort's entry guard `len(coarse_ids) > config.K2` is always false on the main path, so top_ids2 stays empty and the advertised union-of-two-rerankers is a no-op (see deadrank, state=degraded).
A5 Store:JSON persists only the intermediate rewrite/keyword/embedding artifacts as a disk cache; the in-memory heterogeneous graph object itself is never serialized and is rebuilt fresh every run.
Tool dispatch inside the B8 loop fans out across three stages (B2/B3/B6) from one ToolBridge.call() — two of the seven tools additionally trigger their own embedding rerank or LLM call, mid-loop.
